characters.name: Goliath of Gath
characters.note: Philistine champion from Gath, over nine feet tall, in bronze armor; defies Israel's armies.

characters.name: David
characters.note: Youngest son of Jesse of Bethlehem; shepherd who slays Goliath with a sling and stone.

characters.name: Jesse
characters.note: Father of David and eight sons; elderly, not on stage in this part.

characters.name: Eliab
characters.note: Oldest son of Jesse, David's elder brother; angry with David.

characters.name: Abinadab
characters.note: Son of Jesse, David's brother, serving in Saul's army.

characters.name: Shammah
characters.note: Son of Jesse, David's brother, serving in Saul's army.

characters.name: Goliath's shield bearer
aliases: the man who bore the shield
characters.note: Unnamed attendant who goes before Goliath carrying his shield.

characters.name: Men of Israel
characters.note: Israelite army that is dismayed and flees before Goliath, then shouts and pursues the Philistines.

characters.name: Philistine army
characters.note: Philistine army that flees when its champion dies.

locations.name: Socoh
